objective: A shared recurrent policy that learns transferable Civ6 skills and eventually full multiplayer strategy under the human player's information and action constraints.

architecture.map_encoder: Two masked Conv2d layers on offset hex coordinates, with row parity and known/unknown channels; initial baseline, not a claim of hex symmetry invariance.
architecture.entity_encoder: Shared entity network with public content embeddings and candidate-to-entity cross-attention, plus a masked empire summary.
architecture.memory: LSTM per game generation, episode and player; never shared private states between players.
architecture.action_decoder: Score every published root candidate with exact padding masks. For policies, sample each slot with exact changed-completion masks, then submit one atomic joint assignment. Unsupported menus stop the frame.
architecture.algorithm: Recurrent PPO with joint root/assignment probabilities, ordered player sequences, bounded gradients and terminal/truncation bootstraps. Conditional entropy uses a measured Monte Carlo estimate.
architecture.policy_scope: One shared policy conditioned on civilization, leader, rules profile and curriculum objective when these inputs are implemented and qualified. No separate compulsory network per civilization.

asymmetric_actor_critic.decision: Evaluate a separate privileged critic against the player-only baseline; never give privileged state to the actor.
asymmetric_actor_critic.actor: CNN/entity encoder/LSTM with player observations, public exercise goal and human-available action interface. Native equality still requires qualification.
asymmetric_actor_critic.critic: Separate value-only parameters and optimizer. Prototype consumes an explicitly masked privileged feature vector and detached public actor hidden/cell state. This compressed history is an approximation, not a proof of unbiased policy gradients.
asymmetric_actor_critic.implementation_status: 998: CPU/MPS fixtures verified; task-conditioned native multiplayer diagnostic collected 63 actions with 1 coordinated asymmetric updates and 2 same-player returns after opponents. Independent public actor and private critic sidecar; strategic eligibility remains unqualified.
required_boundaries: Separate sidecar/schema for privileged records; exact episode/generation/player/sequence/turn/source joins.
No privileged values in actor tensors, candidate IDs/features, action masks, recurrent memory or deployment artifact.
Changing private state at fixed public history must not change deployed actor probabilities or memory.
Critic loss and optimizer cannot update actor weights. Actor PPO updates may use detached advantages from the selected critic.
Critic predictions and rewards are never actor inputs; game rewards and objectives stay unchanged.
Audit native human action availability including hidden-state-dependent menus; do not prune actions speculatively.
Freeze behavior actor and critic versions for collection/replay/bootstrap, distinguish terminal from truncation, snapshot both optimizers for full learner resume.
Evaluate frozen actor with privileged channel removed and no online weight adaptation. Use held-out seeds and matched compute comparisons.
asymmetric_actor_critic.comparison: Compare separate public-history-only and privileged critics with matched architecture/tasks/rewards/seeds/compute; keep existing shared player-only critic as an additional baseline. Evaluate actor-only on held-out scenarios.

current_limits: Matched critic comparison and frozen actor-only native evaluation work. Diverse qualified scenarios, human equivalence and strategic benefit remain unproven.
Public task conditioning exists; civilization/profile conditioning, human-equivalent actions/observations and qualified diverse curriculum remain incomplete.
Self-play learner, native held-out evaluation and distributed scheduling remain incomplete.
Tiny CNN/LSTM and partial private critic are diagnostic baselines, not final architecture or model size.
architecture.public_dialogue_encoder: Bounded lossless UTF-8 input, small masked byte CNN, button features, existing map/entity/LSTM policy. No opaque IDs or AI reasons in neural tensors.

phases.name: Short native situations
phases.distribution: Varied economy, production, expansion and combat states, small maps, multiple seeds and starting positions, initially a small declared civilization panel.
phases.reward: Explicit terminal task success/failure for skill pretraining. No reward for every click, build, move or attack. A task success is not an official Civ6 victory.
phases.promotion: Transfer to unseen native scenarios and seeds; stable learning across seeds; no hidden information or action substitutions; measured replay review and baseline comparison.

phases.name: Interacting skills
phases.distribution: Longer native situations coupling expansion, research, economy, defense and timing.
phases.reward: Reduce reliance on task-specific objectives while introducing official game outcomes.
phases.promotion: Retain earlier skills and outperform fixed opponents on held-out interactions.

phases.name: Complete duels
phases.distribution: Whole small native games with all allowed victory paths and explicit required choices.
phases.reward: Official win/loss/draw or declared time-limit truncation; no disguised loss for host failures.
phases.promotion: Reliable complete games, diverse opponents, held-out maps and credible evaluation uncertainty.

phases.name: Multiplayer generalization
phases.distribution: Progressively more players, civilizations, leaders, maps and versioned DLC/mod profiles.
phases.reward: Official outcomes and protocol-specific multiplayer evaluation.
phases.promotion: Cross-play league matrices and per-civilization results, not only aggregate reward.

phases.name: Open-ended league
phases.distribution: Current and historical policies, specialized adversaries, diverse states and strategies.
phases.reward: Strategic outcomes; any exploration objective is separately measured and ablated.
phases.promotion: Reproduce novel strategies/exploits in the reference game; no guarantee of discovering all possible exploits or theoretical perfection.

phase1_required_gates.requirement: Exact save/configuration/GameCore/final databases/gameplay scripts/content profile, deterministic reset evidence for each admitted scenario.
Required information is actually published and encoded; fog and player isolation checked; absent data never silently treated as known zero.
All human choices reachable in admitted scenarios, including assignment choices and applicable forced end turn; native masks; no heuristic pruning or fallback moves.
Versioned task terminal condition and limits, crash exclusion, tested reward provenance; official victory distinguished from curriculum success.
Native trajectories with player memory, behavior-policy version/logprob, sequence replay/burn-in, safe checkpoint/resume and evaluation split.
Metrics, native replay, no-progress and divergence handling, stopped/error state, compute/time budgets, measured Windows/Mac transport.

deployment.windows: Native GameCore actors with independent databases, bounded jobs and memory. Local batched inference should be measured against remote inference.
deployment.mac: PyTorch learner and optional batched MPS inference; authorized SSH, pinned source and policy versions.
deployment.no_assumption: MPS is not automatically faster for tiny single-observation inference. Inference throughput is not native game throughput.
deployment.production_changes: Freeze a qualified environment version for training; develop the next host phase separately to avoid invalidating ongoing trajectories.

measured_baseline_inference.scope: Small baseline, duplicated recorded player frame, batches 1/8/32; excludes SSH and native GameCore.

monitoring.current_status: Native replay, one measured MPS PPO update, bounded run control and diagnostic evaluation are available. No qualified held-out strategic learning curve yet.
monitoring.failure_policy: Stop on nonfinite updates, stale identities, unknown vocabulary/actions, invalid host outcomes. Do not count host crashes as player defeats.
